policy: LIVING TOOLS LEDGER — the brain tracks its own instrumentation. When a new tool lands (PayBox, Grok bot, anything), add an entry here and agents amplify it automatically: ORACLE scouts it, NEXUS wires it, ZEROX prices it, PIKADON gates it. status: active | pilot | watchlist | sunset.
